title: Nosferatu
description: A classic German Expressionist horror film directed by F.W. Murnau. The mysterious Count Orlok brings a plague of terror to a small town. A monumental masterpiece of early vampire cinema.

title: Metropolis
description: Fritz Lang's futuristic masterpiece. In a dystopian city divided between the wealthy elite and the working class, a forbidden romance sparks a revolution. A defining film of the sci-fi genre.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: George A. Romero's cult classic that birthed the modern zombie genre. A group of survivors barricade themselves in a farmhouse against hordes of the undead in a desperate fight for survival.

title: The General
description: A silent comedy masterpiece starring and directed by Buster Keaton. A thrilling train chase unfolds as a Southern engineer tries to rescue his stolen locomotive and the love of his life.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: The quintessential German Expressionist film. Featuring twisted, painted sets and a chilling psychological narrative, it tells the story of a hypnotist who uses a sleepwalker to commit murders.

title: Charade
description: A stylish romantic thriller directed by Stanley Donen. A young widow in Paris finds herself pursued by several mysterious men, all hunting for a fortune stolen by her late husband.

title: Detour
description: Edgar G. Ulmer's gritty, low-budget film noir. A hitchhiking piano player finds his luck turning from bad to worse as he gets entangled in a web of crime, blackmail, and murder.

title: Sherlock Jr.
description: One of Buster Keaton's most inventive works. A young projectionist dreams of becoming a detective, stepping literally into the movie screen to solve a thrilling mystery.

title: His Girl Friday
description: Howard Hawks' sparkling screwball comedy. A fast-talking newspaper editor goes to extreme lengths to stop his ace reporter and ex-wife from getting remarried and leaving the paper.

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
description: Ed Wood's legendary sci-fi classic. Aliens attempt to resurrect the dead to stop humanity from destroying the universe, in this notoriously entertaining and iconic B-movie.
